newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Brau Union 1996 earnings lose fizz.
newsitem.headline: Brau Union 1996 earnings lose fizz.

text.p: Austrian brewery Brau-Union Goess-Reininghaus- Oesterreichische Brau AG reported on Thursday a decline in 1996 earnings but said it would pay out an unchanged dividend of 23 schillings for last year.

The brewer, which is just over 60 percent owned by beverages group BBAG Oesterreichische Brau-Beteiligungs-AG, said 1996 net profit fell 8.8 percent to 557 million schillings and pre-tax profit slipped to 734 million from 747 million in 1995.
Group sales inched higher to 9.39 billion schillings from 9.34 billion.
BBAG reported earnings for the whole group last week. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12256
